title: Ahmedabad Monsoon Flood
description: Heavy monsoon rain over Ahmedabad: a car trapped in the flooded Akhbarnagar underpass (7 duplicate reports in Gujarati/Hindi/English), Vasna barrage crossing its danger mark, a commercial fire on C.G. Road, a chemical gas leak at Vatva GIDC left undispatched to show SLA escalation, a road accident on S.G. Highway, an elderly medical emergency in a waterlogged Maninagar society, a wall collapse in Behrampura and waterlogging along the Sabarmati riverfront (hotspot). PRD §11.

events.text: અખબારનગર અંડરપાસમાં ગાડી ફસાઈ છે, પાણી વધી રહ્યું છે
Caller says a car is stuck in the Akhbarnagar underpass, water is up to the windows and two people are inside.
Fire on the 3rd floor of a commercial complex on C.G. Road, thick black smoke, people waving from the terrace.
अखबारनगर अंडरपास में कार फंसी है, पानी तेजी से बढ़ रहा है, अंदर लोग हैं
Caller reports flames and smoke coming out of a building near Swastik Char Rasta on C.G. Road.
Strong chemical smell from a gas leak at a factory in Vatva GIDC, workers are vomiting and two have fainted.
Akhbarnagar underpass is completely flooded, a car is trapped with people inside, please send a boat.
રિવરફ્રન્ટ પાસે રસ્તા પર ઘૂંટણ સુધી પાણી ભરાયું છે, વાહનો બંધ પડી ગયા છે
Bike and car collision on S.G. Highway near Thaltej crossroads, the rider is unconscious and bleeding.
અખબારનગર અંડરપાસમાં પાણી ખૂબ વધી ગયું છે, કારમાં લોકો ફસાયા છે, તાત્કાલિક મદદ મોકલો
मणिनगर में 78 साल के बुज़ुर्ग मरीज को सीने में दर्द और सांस लेने में तकलीफ है, सोसाइटी में पानी भरा है, एम्बुलेंस अंदर नहीं आ पा रही
Waterlogging near Nehru Bridge on the riverfront road, several vehicles stalled in the water.
Fire on C.G. Road complex is spreading to the 4th floor, need two more tenders and an aerial ladder.
Accident at Thaltej on S.G. Highway, two vehicles involved, one person injured, traffic is blocked.
An old compound wall collapsed in Behrampura after the heavy rain, two people may be trapped under the debris.
કૉલ: અખબારનગર અંડરપાસમાં કાર ફસાઈ છે, બે લોકો અંદર છે, પાણી છત સુધી પહોંચવા આવ્યું છે
Water is entering houses near Ellisbridge on the riverfront side, it is knee deep inside.
बहरामपुरा में बारिश के बाद पुरानी दीवार गिर गई, मलबे में लोग दबे हो सकते हैं
A large tree has fallen across the road near the Navrangpura bus stop, no one is hurt but traffic is blocked.
The riverfront road near Paldi is flooded and knee deep, and the water keeps rising.
Elderly man with chest pain is stuck in a waterlogged society in Maninagar, the ambulance cannot get in.
The gas leak at Vatva GIDC is getting worse, people in nearby houses are having trouble breathing.
An electric pole is sparking in a waterlogged street in Shahibaug, people are walking through the water.
નેહરુ બ્રિજ પાસે રિવરફ્રન્ટ રોડ પર પાણી ભરાયું છે, ગાડીઓ ફસાઈ ગઈ છે
Another call about the Akhbarnagar underpass: the car is almost submerged and the occupants have climbed onto its roof.
કાલુપુર રેલ્વે સ્ટેશન પાસે રસ્તા પર પાણી ભરાયું છે, મુસાફરો ફસાયા છે
